description.zh: 数据中心，需要与[CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2848162~~)中的数据中心一致, 当前支持上海（取值为cn-shanghai)、新加坡（取值为ap-southeast-1）。
description.en: The data center where the interactive messaging application is deployed. Set this parameter to the value of DataCenter that you specified when you called the [CreateLiveMessageApp](~~2593195~~) operation. Valid values: cn-shanghai (Shanghai) and ap-southeast-1 (Singapore).

description.zh: 发起删除消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the user who performs the deletion operation. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length.

description.zh: 发起删除消息的用户扩展信息，长度不超过512字节。
description.en: The additional information about the user who performs the deletion operation. The value can be up to 512 bytes in length.

description.zh: 要删除的消息ID，与发送消息中的MsgTid对应。由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the message that you want to delete. Set this parameter to the value of MsgTid that you specified when you called the SendLiveMessageUser operation. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length.

description.zh: 接收删除消息的用户ID，由大小写字母、数字组成，长度不超过64字节。
description.en: The ID of the user who received the message to delete. The ID can contain only letters and digits and can be up to 64 bytes in length.

title.zh: 删除（撤回）某条单聊消息

descriptions.zh: 本接口的单用户QPS限制为50次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## [](#qps-)QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 50 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you will experience service interruptions. We recommend that you take note of this limit when you call this operation. For more information, see [QPS limits](~~343507~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live delete-live-message-user-message --app-id demo --receiver-id 1698300000 --message-id 0000000000 --deleter-id 1698300000 --deleter-info username --data-center cn-shanghai --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DeleteLiveMessageUserMessage --region cn-hangzhou --ReceiverId 1698300000 --DeleterInfo username --DeleterId 1698300000 --DataCenter 'cn-shanghai' --AppId demo --MessageId 0000000000
